en: Black‑and‑white view from an elevated terrace with a semicircular neoclassical colonnade and a large statue of a robed figure holding up a cross, standing on a rocky pedestal with sculpted figures below. Two well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the terrace. In the background, across a river valley, stands a large palace complex on a hill and church spires rising from the city below. Parts of the image edges appear damaged, as if from an old negative or printed postcard.
